notes.title: Engine Eternal Announced!
notes.content:
Our coop horror game for 1-4 players, Engine Eternal, is releasing later this year. In Engine Eternal, you will travel across the Old World with the endless task of collecting fuel and upgrades for your train from randomly generated dungeons in order to keep its engine running.

Check out the steam page, watch the announcement trailer, and wishlist below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3492760/Engine_Eternal/

Thank you! ❤️

Oscar & Tom
Absolutely Cookage

notes.title: Patch 1.1 | Halloween Update
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Halloween :)[/h1]

Added some new anomalies and achievements to celebrate spooky season!

[b][u]1.1 Patch Notes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]9 new anomalies
[*]3 new achievements
[*]Added sprinting to let you get around the house a little bit faster
[*]Technical and visual changes to the options menu
[*]Volume adjustments
[*]Changes to gameplay loop logic to stop the game from being too long
[*]Spookified the main menu
[/list]
If you find any bugs or issues, feel free to post them in the steam discussions and I'll fix them ASAP.

We really appreciate everyone that has bought and played the game so far, it really means a lot.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Hotfixes related to previous patch

- Tweaked the brightness of some lights in the house on the back of the overhaul from the previous patch
- Fixed a bug that was causing a picture to be out of place

notes.title: Patch 1.095
notes.content:
- Overhaul to the lighting in the house to improve optimization
- Fixed some bugs that could cause the player to become stuck in the bedroom
- Removed the footstep sound on the tile in the bathroom

The overhaul to the house lighting has resulted in the map being slightly darker, and as such I may add a brightness option in the settings if players are having issues with the brightness being too low.

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
- Fixed logic issue that sometimes resulted in settings not being saved and loaded properly
- 2nd attempt to fix an issue with how the static is displayed on screen
